raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Recent batches deliver customer_id in lowercase (e.g. 'c00052'), while raw_customers has uppercase IDs only. The inner join in gold_region_daily therefore drops those rows, and gold_customer_spend splits the same customer into two keys. Normalizing customer_id to upper case in silver_transactions fixes both.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, upper(trim(customer_id)) AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
